name: manual_a41e85
claim: For shared-repository board jobs, invoke the supported coordination CLI from its owning repository, then verify the claimed source revision against the actual worktree before review; agents must self-register and emit heartbeat pulses, and a claim or log entry is not evidence of task completion.

decisions.notes: A Task 5 review initially targeted the wrong repository entrypoint and a board row retained an older source revision. The agent named in a completion report was absent from the canonical roster until registration was reconciled. Verification must combine board state, actual revision, and liveness.
